purpose: Fail-closed source contract for rebuilding the frozen 318-column V6 feature schema for prospective paper trading.

production_universe.candidate_live_bridge: Alpaca active US assets plus LSEG identifiers, shares, prices, and classifications
requirements: one stable issuer/security identifier map with symbol-history support
the frozen price, market-cap, liquidity, trading-history, exchange, and issuer-line screens
no filtering on news, analyst, options, or fundamental coverage

feature_groups.label: LSEG analyst expectations and CAM
feature_groups.primary_source: LSEG Data Library through the signed-in Workspace desktop session
feature_groups.fallback: missing values plus frozen missing indicators; never Yahoo analyst fields
feature_groups.action: extend the historical CUSIP9/RIC downloader into a new prospective monthly lineage and authenticate the full eligible universe

feature_groups.label: Alpaca/Benzinga related news
feature_groups.fallback: source unavailable flag; do not reinterpret unavailable coverage as no news
feature_groups.action: configure rotated credentials through environment variables and append immutable article/manifest months

feature_groups.label: SEC filings and event recency
feature_groups.primary_source: SEC EDGAR submissions and filing index APIs
feature_groups.fallback: missing when issuer mapping or filing history is unavailable
feature_groups.action: materialize a point-in-time CIK-to-security bridge and preserve filing acceptance timestamps

feature_groups.label: Pastor-Stambaugh liquidity
feature_groups.primary_source: verified historical Pastor-Stambaugh source ending in 2014
feature_groups.fallback: keep both economic values missing and activate their frozen missing indicators
feature_groups.action: none for the frozen model; a new proxy would require retraining a successor model

feature_groups.label: Price, return distribution, size, liquidity, and market volatility
feature_groups.primary_source: LSEG adjusted end-of-day pricing, volume, shares, and market-cap fields; Alpaca broker bars only for execution reconciliation
feature_groups.historical_source: CRSP daily security data and daily market factors
feature_groups.fallback: leave affected fields missing if their provider bridge fails
feature_groups.action: rebuild the frozen formulas on an overlapping 2024-2025 window and pass monthly cross-sectional rank/distribution parity before use

feature_groups.label: Valuation and fundamentals
feature_groups.primary_source: LSEG point-in-time fundamentals with SEC Company Facts as reconciliation
feature_groups.historical_source: Compustat point-in-time fundamentals joined to CRSP market values
feature_groups.fallback: leave unmatched definitions missing; never mix currencies or fiscal periods
feature_groups.action: freeze field mappings, reporting lags, currency conversions, and overlap parity tests

feature_groups.label: Institutional ownership
feature_groups.primary_source: SEC 13F holdings plus LSEG shares outstanding
feature_groups.fallback: missing until the filing is public and the CUSIP/security bridge is unambiguous
feature_groups.action: enforce the 45-day filing deadline/actual acceptance time and validate denominator parity

feature_groups.label: Security identity and categories
feature_groups.primary_source: LSEG identifiers/classifications, Alpaca assets, and SEC registrant metadata
feature_groups.fallback: unknown frozen category rather than guessed identity
feature_groups.action: build date-effective ticker, CUSIP, RIC, CIK, issuer-family, exchange, ADR, domicile, and SIC2 mapping

feature_groups.label: Options flow, open interest, coverage, and vendor historical volatility
feature_groups.primary_source: LSEG OPRA contract discovery, end-of-day option volume/open interest, underlying volume, and LSEG or internally calculated historical volatility
feature_groups.candidate_bridge: LSEG OPRA and equity history through the signed-in Workspace/Data Library session
feature_groups.fallback: frozen missing-value path if the LSEG aggregate-feature bridge fails parity; never relabel a nonequivalent proxy as OptionMetrics
feature_groups.action: rebuild the exact 26 frozen formulas from LSEG contract-level volume/open interest, coverage, underlying volume, and historical volatility; pass 2024-2025 OptionMetrics overlap parity before model use

feature_groups.label: Factor betas, idiosyncratic volatility, and aggregate factor state
feature_groups.primary_source: Ken French official factors after publication; Treasury/FRED for cash-rate reconciliation
feature_groups.historical_source: publicly available FF5, momentum, and risk-free observations under frozen availability dates
feature_groups.fallback: use only last officially published factors and leave current-dependent fields missing unless a separately frozen internal factor nowcast passes parity
feature_groups.action: choose and freeze the causal live policy before first signal; never backfill later-released factors into a contemporaneous paper decision

parity_gate.required_scope: eligible-stock cross section for every bridged feature and every monthly signal
parity_gate.decision_rule: all material bridge checks pass before the frozen model may consume the bridge; otherwise preserve supported missingness or retrain a new provider-compatible model
